question.text: LTCG on UNLISTED shares (held > 24 months) post July 2024:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Unlisted LTCG rate rationalised to 12.5% without indexation benefit (Jul 2024 reform). **The Trap:** Indexation removed for post-Jul 2024. **Cross-Exam Context:** Current tax. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Cost inflation index (CII) no longer applies for post-Jul 2024 gains — simpler but sometimes harsher.
